title: Features · 4-card horizontal grid
description: H2 + 3 lede paragraphs + 4 horizontal cards. Each card carries a mono number badge, a title, and two body paragraphs. Used as the 'Unified Platform' / 'What's Inside' framing pattern. 4 fixed slots; collapses to 2 columns at ≤1180px, single column at ≤720px.

source.adapted_from: v5 dark + v4 light → unified light tokens
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-21 — 4-card framing pattern = v5 horizontal layout

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: 4 fixed cards by design. For variable counts use features.accordion-2col-numbered.
Eyebrow and number badges use --cta-secondary-fill / --cta-secondary-color so this section follows the same palette as secondary CTAs.
Two breakpoints: 4-col → 2-col at 1180px, 2-col → 1-col at 720px. Avoids the 'card row of 1 hanging' problem.
Cards are tighter than card-grid-3 (denser typography) since 4 across leaves less width.
